content: For industrial/control-panel dashboard aesthetics, cited pairings: Space Grotesk (already has monospace-heritage squared terminals, reads as engineering/technical) + a clean sans; IBM Plex Mono + IBM Plex Sans (8 weights, no ligatures, designed for data tables/financial UI, feels precise not cold); DM Mono (condensed, purpose-built for dense dashboards where horizontal space is tight); Monoforge (serifed monospace, brutalist/industrial character, for display use).
